trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation & War Timeline
trends.summary: Real-time military developments including Iranian drone attacks on Kuwait's fuel infrastructure, air defense activations in Tehran, and Trump's announcement that Iran war could end within weeks. UAE preparing to help US force open Strait of Hormuz, marking first Gulf nation joining conflict. This geopolitical crisis is directly impacting energy markets and risk appetite globally.

trends.name: Energy Market Rally & Supply Disruption
trends.summary: Oil extending record monthly gains as Iran conflict disrupts supply; UK jet fuel supply critically low (48 hours remaining). Massive Energy ETF inflows (largest since Russia-Ukraine war) alongside record Energy single-stock outflows signal flight to safer positioning. NGL prices benefiting from geopolitical premium but volatility expected.

trends.name: Asian Risk Appetite Recovery & Currency Moves
trends.summary: Nikkei surged 4% and South Korea's Kospi led Asia rebound on Trump's war-exit signals. However, Japanese yen weakening past 160/USD threatens BoJ intervention (last occurred July 2024), creating currency market volatility. Japanese business sentiment remains solid supporting April BoJ rate hike plans despite geopolitical uncertainty.

trends.name: Nike Sales Collapse & China Slowdown
trends.summary: Nike stock plummeting 9% on weak forward guidance with expected 20% sales decline in China. Company signals turnaround efforts are not gaining traction. This signals broader consumer weakness in key Asian markets and potential broader retail sector headwinds.

trends.name: US Labor Market Stagnation & Job Openings Decline
trends.summary: Job openings fell more than expected in February, indicating labor market cooling. Combined with stagnation in broader employment trends, this creates dovish pressure on Fed policy and challenges narrative of economic strength. Implications for rate cut timing and recession risk assessment.

trends.name: Tech Sector Job Cuts & Oracle Restructuring
trends.summary: Oracle stock rises as company reportedly begins thousands of job cuts, signaling cost-reduction focus despite market sentiment. Broader tech sector facing significant headcount reductions expected throughout 2026 (per social media commentary). Represents margin-positive but employment-negative tech landscape.

trends.name: Microsoft Bullish Rating & Tech Earnings Strength
trends.summary: Microsoft initiated with 'Buy' rating and $450 price target by Benchmark, signaling analyst confidence in mega-cap tech. UBS recently released top tech stock picks. Mega-cap tech strength contrasts with broader market volatility and labor market softness.

trends.name: Semiconductor Recovery & South Korean Tech Rebound
trends.summary: Chipmakers drove ASX 200 and Kospi rebound as Iran war-resolution hopes revived risk appetite. Semiconductor sector benefiting from both geopolitical de-escalation sentiment and ongoing AI demand. South Korea positioning as primary beneficiary of tech rebound.

trends.name: Corporate Buyback Deceleration & Capital Allocation Shift
trends.summary: BofA flow data shows corporate buybacks decelerating week-over-week amid market uncertainty. Clients selling everything except SMID caps, indicating rotation away from large-cap growth. Capital allocation shifting toward smaller-cap and mid-cap equities as market positioning changes.

trends.name: Airline Industry Consolidation & Leadership Changes
trends.summary: IndiGo shares jumped 9% after naming industry veteran William Walsh as new CEO, signaling positive market reaction to leadership overhaul. Represents broader consolidation and professionalization trends in Asia-Pacific airline sector with geopolitical recovery expectations.

trends.name: US Mail-In Voting Executive Order & Election 2026 Politics
trends.summary: Trump signed executive order limiting mail-in voting ahead of 2026 elections, adding political uncertainty. Policy moves could impact sectors, healthcare, and corporate tax planning as election cycle approaches. Market impact secondary but emerging consideration for 2026-2027 planning.

trends.name: Crypto Market Expansion & CoinShares SPAC Listing
trends.summary: CoinShares begins Nasdaq trading through SPAC merger, signaling continued crypto sector legitimacy and institutional adoption. Market recovery in digital assets follows broader risk-appetite improvement from geopolitical developments. Institutional crypto products gaining regulatory and market acceptance.
